trigger: Historical storage proposal describes M04-level document-versions/document-transactions paths, whereas current accepted IO adapter owns private version/journal mechanics and success receipt does not expose an old-version handle.
required_behavior: Single formal file commit with verified rollback/recovery semantics, no competing persistence authority.
missing: Explicit current M04 consumer contract distinguishing IO private recovery artifacts from any separate user-facing retention requirement.
recommendation: Consume actual FileCommitPort without duplicating its private journal. Keep original retention path proposal historical, not a new write target. If long-term document version history is required, propose it separately with its own approved lifecycle/Port rather than silently implementing it.

trigger: DocumentCodecPort proposal still names DocumentFormat/CodecError and full-document canonicalization/preservation responsibilities without fully frozen types, exact per-format field exclusions and complete codec fixture/error oracle mapping.
required_behavior: Full ESS composite document or standalone .sgendesign must preserve supported content or reject before write.
missing: Precise ESS XML profile, .sgendesign dependency/adoption contract, semantic canonical payload versus raw persisted bytes, actual codec-owned error shape.
recommendation: Prepare one exact codec/type/error/field-map package. Reuse M03 only after its contract is adopted; do not treat scene text helper or packet read-only extraction as full serializer. Do not implement the absent codec adapter from placeholder names.

trigger: WORK acknowledge_formal_save expects semantic digest, while CommitReceipt.committed_digest hashes exact encoded file bytes. The two may legitimately differ; trusted HOST must bind both to the same immutable capture, target, request and owner.
required_behavior: Save captured R, keep live R+1 dirty, preserve recovery baseline; no UI-supplied digest acknowledgement.
missing: Exact captured-save record, receipt-validation result and postcommit acknowledgement error/late-owner semantics.
recommendation: Propose immutable capture binding with document/session/project/request, captured revision+semantic digest, encoded bytes+raw digest, expected previous raw digest and trusted target. Validate target/raw hashes/previous digest/txid before ACK. ACK only semantic digest from captured content, never raw receipt digest. If disk commit succeeds but ACK cannot apply, preserve persistence proof and report committed/ack-deferred instead of ordinary failed-unchanged.

trigger: Approved S1 has status RecoveryRequired and rejects edits while in that state, but no public transition method exists to enter it from a native IO outcome. Silent state reconstruction or a new setter would change the accepted Skeleton.
required_behavior: Exact RecoveryRequired diagnostics retained and further destructive document operations blocked without losing content/history/baselines.
missing: Approved location/owner of IO safety gate and how its state combines with DocumentSession status.

options.proposal: Proposed per-session HOST IO-health guard owned by existing M04 application/session boundary; all destructive inputs check it before calling S1. Domain content/history status unchanged; projection explicitly combines IO health and domain editability. Requires precise guard lifecycle/DTO scope approval, no global manager.

Explicit new domain transition API and lifecycle contract to enter/resolve RecoveryRequired. Requires S1 public API/Skeleton/TDD revision and Owner adoption; cannot be treated as local implementation.

recommendation: Prefer A for current S2 integration if complete boundary coverage can be proved; present exact model and all-entry guards for one review before Skeleton. Do not self-approve either option.
